newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde May 6.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Five specialists in political sciences and law publish manifesto calling for a five-year presidential term and increased decentralisation.
-- A Sofres poll for five regional newspapers finds sixty-five percent of people polled are disappointed with president Jacques Chirac's action since his election in May 1995.
-- State to put up for sale some 300 to 350 million shares of France Telecom in June, said industry Minister Franck Borotra.
-- Panel of experts rejects demands by Eurotunnel relating to losses in revenue against construction consortium TML, agrees to damages for deficiencies in some rolling stock.
